published_source: Printed Table 8, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2025.03238.pdf, Articles in Advance p. 14), read Nov 4 2026: DSIB 0.347** (0.148), Observations 423, R2 0.308, bank and year FE, no controls; equals the authors' code output 0.3473694 (0.1477096), N 423, to the printed decimals. Earlier: Authors' shipped replication.log line 2761 (reghdfe output of code_main_tables.do line 511 on the shipped data). Article PDF not available in the project.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.3473694 (0.1477096), N 423, equals printed Table 8 column (1) 0.347 (0.148), N 423, to the printed decimals; fixest reproduces the shipped replication.log value; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: code_main_tables.do lines 499-512: npa_w_off.dta merged to bank_list.dta (46 scheduled banks) and bank_control_yearly_impute.dta, fyear renamed year, sib_ind regenerated with the same bank-year designation rule, years 2010-2020, npa_woff = npa_w_off / npa; reghdfe npa_woff sib_ind, absorb(creditorcode year) cluster(creditorcode). Prepared copy t8_bank_year.rds (467 bank-years, 44 with missing npa_woff dropped by run_spec, leaving 423 obs on 45 banks) adds g_bank (2016 for SBI 236328 and ICICI 96379, 2018 for HDFC 88297, NA otherwise); sib_ind == 1[year >= g_bank] on every row, no switch-offs. Stata's merge keeps the master npa when bank_control_yearly_impute.dta also has npa, so the ratio is computed before merging the controls. fixest replication: 0.3473694 (SE 0.1477096, N 423) = exact. SD(npa_woff) in the regression sample = 1.0922 (population formula used by run_spec), so the standardized published coefficient is 0.31805; run_spec TWFE = 0.3180472 (SE 0.1352; fixest small-sample adjustment differs from reghdfe). Cohorts: 2016 (2 banks) and 2018 (1 bank); 42 never-treated banks with data (92.2% of obs); the three treated banks are observed in all 11 years; the panel is unbalanced for some control banks (2-10 years), so CSA uses the project's composition-fixed manual cells. Only 3 treated clusters of 45: leverage screen fails (G_eff 3.45, L_max 0.33). Outcome is a ratio with a long right tail (max 13.45, mean 0.88).
